name: AwakePix
description: AwakePix turns photos and ideas into short AI videos, with image generation and editing in the same browser-based tool. Animate portraits, explore product visuals, or create scenes for social posts. Real examples and reusable prompts provide a starting point, with credit costs shown before generation. One-time credit packs require no recurring subscription. Eligible users can try limited free photo animation for personal, non-commercial use, subject to availability.
